rows.note: Approximate comparison, not a validation: no threshold applies. 'Expected' holds the NASA map value (DN x 0.00004 from the product label) and 'measured' this product's value. Expected differences: the map is an 18.6-year average and this run covers one year; the map averages the visible fraction of the solar disc, this run counts the time any part of the disc is above the horizon; the map cell is 120 m wide while this run uses one point with its own 20 m terrain horizon profile at a 2 m mast.
